title: Customer conversation matrix + fast proposals (synthesis)
content:
Purpose:
- Rapid synthesis of recent customer signals across channels (support, account execs, PLG funnel) focused on inference runtime/serving pain points.
- Present 6 fast experiments / tactical fixes that can be scoped and shipped in 2–6 weeks.

Context & scope:
- Time window: Oct 1 2029 — Nov 8 2029.
- Data sources: support tickets, post-sales calls, trial user sessions, in-product logs flagged by observability, and two enterprise proposals.
- Goal: Turn noisy asks into concrete small-bet experiments that reduce near-term customer churn risk and improve onboarding conversion.

Topline synthesis (one-liners):
- Predictable tail latency is still the #1 blocker for trial-to-production for mid-market customers. Complaints cluster around cold-start spikes and inconsistent KV/cache invalidation.
- Customers want a lightweight way to enforce cost/latency tradeoffs per-route without deploying a separate model.
- Private deploy prospects ask for clearer audit expectations (KMS/HSM, log retention) and an easier checklist for SOC-type review.
- Several product-led users report noisy hallucination drift on reranking workflows after quantized model updates.
- Developer ergonomics: SDK error messages are often opaque when fallback routing triggers (we see 3 Slack threads about this).

Conversation matrix (channel -> distilled signal):
- Support tickets (15 high-touch): recurring themes: tail latency, retry storms, billing surprises for embeddings.
- Account execs (5 enterprise renewals): require SLA language for dedicated bursting and deterministic throughput.
- Trial sessions (self-serve cohort, n=42): low conversion when first 500 tokens exceed 700ms; drop-off at second API call.
- Observability traces (aggregated): KV cache misses correlated with model-switch fallback events.
- Forums & Slack: requests for clearer best-practices on batching and prefix caching for chat apps.

Representative verbatims (edited):
- "Token-level bill shock — my embedding endpoint billed 4x when cache warmed but we didn't realize."
- "One minute it's fast, next it's unusable — we can't rely on it for live chat."
- "Quantized update improved cost, but our reranker started surfacing junk results."

Immediate impact metrics to watch (signals):
- Trial->paid conversion rate for PLG tier (baseline 6.8%).
- Mean 95th- and 99th-percentile latency on first-token across trial accounts.
- Number of billing disputes per week.
- Frequency of fallback-to-compat-model events per customer.

Fast proposals (RICE-ish quick scoring and plan)
1) "First-token fast-path" feature flag (owner: Evan Liu)
- Hypothesis: Expose first-token optimizations (pre-warm KV or allocate lightweight container) for flagged trial accounts; reduces 95p latency by 30% for cold calls.
- Scope: flag + runtime routing rule + telemetry dashboard. No model changes.
- Effort: 2 weeks eng + 1 week QA; small infra config.
- Risk: medium (cost for pre-warm).
- Success metric: 95p latency down 30% for targeted cohort, conversion lift +0.8pp.
- TODO: create feature toggle in console and a billing alert for pre-warm cost.

2) "Route-level cost/latency slider" (owner: Priya Sharma)
- Hypothesis: Let customers declare a per-route preference (latency|cost|balanced). Runtime will select model variant or quantization profile accordingly.
- Scope: API + console UI + simple routing policy implementation for hosted API.
- Effort: 4 weeks product + 3 weeks eng.
- Risk: low (gradual rollout, fallbacks).
- Metric: % of routes set to latency mode and observed token-cost delta.
- Customer use-case: live chat bots requiring sub-500ms.

3) "Private deploy SOC checklist template + audit packet" (owner: Diego Martinez)
- Hypothesis: A one-page checklist + downloadable audit packet reduces procurement friction for regulated buyers and speeds POC approvals.
- Scope: docs + sample config + audit-ready logs sample.
- Effort: 2 weeks (legal + security + cs).
- Risk: low.
- Metric: time-to-POC approval down 25% for inbound enterprise leads.

4) "Reranker sanity-harness" (owner: Aisha Patel)
- Hypothesis: Add a small pre-deploy reranker regression check (localized eval suite) that runs on quantized model updates and flags hallucination drift.
- Scope: lightweight eval harness + alerting + suggested rollback.
- Effort: 3 weeks (applied-ml + infra).
- Risk: medium (false positives).
- Metric: reduction in reranker-related support tickets following a model update.

5) "SDK clearer fallback errors + opt-in verbose mode" (owner: Evan Liu)
- Hypothesis: Better SDK error text + optional verbose debugging reduces developer friction and support noise.
- Scope: SDK message strings, example troubleshooting playbook, and a verbose env flag.
- Effort: 1 week engineering + docs.
- Risk: minimal.
- Metric: time-to-first-successful-call for trial devs reduced by 20%.

6) "Billing preview in console (per-route projected cost)" (owner: Priya Sharma)
- Hypothesis: Showing projected cost at route-config time reduces billing disputes and increases user trust.
- Scope: console UI + cost model backend endpoint + tooltip.
- Effort: 3 weeks frontend + 2 weeks backend.
- Risk: moderate (accuracy of projections).
- Metric: decrease in billing disputes; adoption of preview feature.

Quick prioritization rationale (why these 6)
- Low-lift, high-customer-signal: SDK messages (5) and docs checklist (3) are fast wins.
- Medium-lift, high impact: first-token fast-path (1) and reranker harness (4) directly address churn risks called out by enterprise and trial cohorts.
- Strategic: route-level slider (2) aligns with product thesis around cost-aware serving controls.

Open questions & unknowns
- How much does pre-warm cost per committed request pattern? Need infra estimate and billing model.
- Can routing decisions use current telemetry w/o adding latency? (Ask infra/serving-runtime).
- For reranker harness, what eval sets are portable across customers? (Data privacy concerns).

Next steps (week-by-week ramp plan)
- Week 0 (this week): Align owners + quick technical spike for first-token pre-warm cost. Book 30m sync with serving-runtime.
- Week 1: Implement SDK strings + verbose mode; draft SOC checklist.
- Week 2–3: Launch SDK update; ship SOC checklist; spike on reranker harness.
- Week 4–6: Build first-token fast-path experiment and route-slider pilot for 2 customers.

Communication plan
- Post a short note to #cs-inference-urgent summarizing the 6 fast proposals and owners.
- Create a Confluence page with experiment tracking and link to JIRA epics: JIRA-CS-7890 (billing-preview), JIRA-ENG-8123 (first-token).
- Schedule biweekly 30-minute review with CS/Eng/Applied-ML to evaluate signals.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Add one sample curl snippet showing verbose SDK errors.
- Ask pricing about soft caps for pre-warm to avoid bill-shock.
- Follow up with AE Sam on the enterprise account that threatened to churn — propose targeted fast-path pilot.

Appendix: raw evidence snippets (short)
- Ticket #32421: "95th latency spikes after model rollover" — trace attached.
- Slack thread (cs-inference-urgent): "trial customer saw billing 4x after embedding cache warm".
- Post-sales note: customer requires burst capacity SLA for support hours 9–6 PST.

End of doc.
